about_the_game:
"Stella Story" is a simple, exploration-based 2D action game themed around the constellations.

You’ll control two main characters:
Pisces, a boy of the Pisces constellation, and
Aries, a girl of the Aries constellation.
By switching between them at times, you’ll explore and adventure through the world of the stars.

◆ Story

This is a world where constellations shine beautifully in the night sky.
One day, a great calamity strikes—the light of the stars begins to fade.
Sensing the change early, Aries rises to protect the starlit sky she loves so dearly.

Meanwhile, Pisces, a boy caught in the chaos and left without a place to go, meets Aries by chance.
Together, the two set out on an adventure across the constellation world.

◆ Signs

Helping you on your journey are skills known as “Signs.”
They’re not only for attacking or healing—you can use them for special movements, gathering enemy info, and more.
Just like in a command-based RPG, you select and use them at any time.
Collect a wide variety of Signs and customize your loadout to challenge powerful foes in your own style!

Your guiding constellation might even affect which Signs you can obtain...

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 / AMD FX-4100
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 / NVIDIA GT 710 / AMD Radeon HD 6450
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: A sudden crisis—the stars begin to lose their light. Before the world falls into darkness, a girl named Aries, born under the Aries sign, and a boy named Pisces, born under Pisces, rise to act. This is the story of a world of constellations, where stars are bound together.
